title: 1688 Product & Supplier Finder — development preview
description: Collect product cards from 1688 search results. Choose how to start below. The Actor uses its own browser; your personal browser login is not copied. Live access is still being tested.

searchMode.title: How would you like to search?
enumTitles: Image search — upload a product photo
searchMode.description: Already found products on 1688? Choose Search results links and paste the address from the new tab showing those product cards. Choose Keyword search to enter product names, or Image search to use photos. Individual product links are not supported.

searchUrls.title: Links to 1688 search results
searchUrls.description: Search results links only. Open 1688, search for a product and choose your filters. Copy the address from the NEW TAB showing the product cards, then paste it here, one link per line. Use the results-page link — not the homepage, a login/iframe link or a single product link. Your query, filters, sorting and starting page are preserved.

maxProductsPerSearchUrl.title: Products to collect per search link
maxProductsPerSearchUrl.description: Maximum unique products to collect separately from each results link. A product repeated across links appears once in the final dataset.

maxPagesPerSearchUrl.title: Pages to check per search link
maxPagesPerSearchUrl.description: Start at the page in your copied link, then click Next page. Stop when this page limit, your product target or the last available page is reached.

searchTerms.title: Product names to search for
searchTerms.description: Keyword search only. Enter one product name per line, such as hair dryer. Replace the example with your products. This field is ignored in Search results links and Image search.

maxProductsPerKeyword.title: Products to collect per keyword
maxProductsPerKeyword.description: Separate product limit for each product name, not for the whole run.

maxPagesText.title: Pages to check per keyword
maxPagesText.description: Maximum result pages for each keyword. The Actor follows the new results tab and checks that Next page loads different products.

uploadedImages.title: Upload product photos
uploadedImages.description: Image search only. Clear PNG, JPEG or WebP photos, at most 10 MB each. Each photo is searched separately. Uploads and image links share a total limit of 20 photos.

imageUrls.title: Links to product image files
imageUrls.description: Image search only. Direct HTTPS links to PNG, JPEG or WebP files. Do not paste search-results links, individual product links, blob: links or Markdown. These images are uploaded to 1688 for your search.

maxProductsPerImage.title: Products to collect per photo
maxProductsPerImage.description: Reset separately for each image. Repeated products count toward each image's limit but appear once in the final dataset, with all matching image labels.

maxPagesImage.title: Pages to check per photo
maxPagesImage.description: Separate page limit for each image. The supplied pagination markup must also be present on image results; that remains to be verified.

orderQuantity.title: How many items do you plan to order?
orderQuantity.description: Flags products whose displayed minimum order quantity (MOQ) is above your planned quantity. Card prices are not confirmed bulk-order quotes.

useApifyProxy.title: Use Apify Proxy
useApifyProxy.description: Use your configured Apify Proxy for normal site browsing. Requires proxy access and may incur charges. Does not solve verification or guarantee access. No proxy/identity rotation is performed after access is denied.

skipFailedImages.title: Continue if a photo fails
skipFailedImages.description: Image mode only. Continue after download/layout errors and preserve earlier products. A verification/access-denied response stops the whole batch regardless of this setting.

failOnNoResults.title: Stop on the first search error
failOnNoResults.description: Turn on to stop at the first error. Turn off to preserve valid results from other inputs and report a partial run. Runs with no products always fail. Real verification/access-denied screens always stop the run.

saveCsvFile.title: Save CSV download files
saveCsvFile.description: Save a product CSV and 1688_suppliers.csv in Storage → Key-value store. The structured dataset and run-summary files are separate.

csvFilename.title: Product CSV filename
csvFilename.description: Simple .csv filename. The supplier shortlist uses 1688_suppliers.csv. No additional supplier dataset records are created.
